insert.foreach: INSERT INTO embeddings (user_id, document_id, chunk_id, embedding, "text", metadata) VALUES (#{item.userId}, #{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkId}, #{item.embeddingVector}::vector(512), #{item.text}, #{item.metadata}::jsonb)

mapper.select: SELECT e.id, 1 - (e.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector) AS score, e."text", e.metadata::text AS metadata, e.chunk_id AS chunkId, e.document_id AS documentId, d.file_name AS fileName, c.chunk_type AS chunkType, c.title_path AS titlePath, c.chunk_text AS chunkText, c.parent_chunk_id AS parentChunkId FROM embeddings e LEFT JOIN chunks c ON e.chunk_id = c.id LEFT JOIN documents d ON e.document_id = d.id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
